title: Unconsumed option values disappear
prompt: Creating the iterator returned by Parser::values() and dropping it without reading any values unexpectedly changes later parsing. After reading the option in ['-a', 'b'], checking values().is_ok() should leave 'b' available to value(). Attached values and grouped short options should also remain available when that iterator is unused. Fix this behavior, preserve actual iteration and option-boundary behavior, and add regression coverage.
regression_provenance: Upstream commit adds four unused-iterator regression cases and documents the changed behavior in its changelog.

setup.solver_export: Only source at base_commit, public prompt, baseline lockfile, and tool environment; exclude repository history, oracle, hidden tests, and MinifyCLI evaluator files.
setup.baseline_lockfile: Copy assets.baseline_lockfile to the exported source root as Cargo.lock before warming or exposing the solver workspace.
setup.cargo_target_dir: Use a distinct target directory for every exported root, including oracle and solver variants. Do not reuse a target directory across copied roots.
